_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd (MIT).
name: Subsistence
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The wilderness survival and base-building game. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated.
startup: rm -f UDKGame/Logs/Launch.log; export SteamAppId=418030; (exec tail -n +1 -F UDKGame/Logs/Launch.log 2>/dev/null) & wine ./Binaries/Win64/UDK.exe server "coldmap1?steamsockets" -log -FORCELOGFLUSH -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -ini:UDKEngine:OnlineSubsystemSteamworks.OnlineSubsystemSteamworks.QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}}; r=$?; sleep 1; exit $r

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Subsistence. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 1362640) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously (the Windows version, run under Wine).
# Saves and UDKDedServerSettings.ini are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-1362640}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 1007 +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)
[ -f Binaries/Win64/UDK.exe ] || fail "Steam didn't deliver the server's program (Binaries/Win64/UDK.exe). Reinstall to try again."
# The server reads UDKDedServerSettings.ini. One is written when there's
# none; the Panel sets every setting in it at every start, except your own.
ini=UDKGame/Config/UDKDedServerSettings.ini
mkdir -p UDKGame/Config UDKGame/Logs UDKGame/SaveData
if [ ! -f "$ini" ]; then
    printf '[ColdGame.ColdDedServerSettings]\n' > "$ini"
    for key in ProfileId ServerName ServerDescription HostedByName Password AdminPassword MaxPlayers Difficulty HuntersEnabled HunterAttacks DaysPerYear MonthOverride PvPDamage PlayersCanDamagePlayerBases OfflineBaseProtection PlayersCanAccessEnemyPlayerBaseItems NumPlayerOfflineHoursBeforeBaseDecay Mods; do echo "$key=" >> "$ini"; done
    echo "Made UDKDedServerSettings.ini."
fi
echo "Installed Subsistence build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description players see when they pick the server in the list.

variables.name: Hosted by
variables.description: Who hosts the server, shown in the server list.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password players log in as admin with (join with ?password= and this).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Save slot
variables.description: Which of the server's five save slots it uses.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: easy, normal or hardcore.

variables.name: Hunters
variables.description: true makes AI hunters spawn.

variables.name: Hunter attacks
variables.description: 0 hunters attack, 1 only in revenge, 2 never.

variables.name: Days per year
variables.description: How many in-game days a year has: 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 90, 120, 200 or 365.

variables.name: Month
variables.description: The month to start in, 0 (January) to 11, or -1 to keep the save's.

variables.name: PvP damage
variables.description: true lets players hurt each other.

variables.name: Base damage
variables.description: true lets players damage other players' buildings.

variables.name: Offline protection
variables.description: true protects a team's base while all its members are offline.

variables.name: Enemy base items
variables.description: true lets players open enemy chests and machines.

variables.name: Base decay hours
variables.description: Hours a team must be offline before its base starts decaying, or 0 for never.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Workshop IDs or local mod IDs to load, separated by commas.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.

variables.name: Wine packages
variables.description: The Windows runtimes the image installs into Wine on the first start.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
